newsitem.title: EU: EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MARCH 11-THURSDAY, MARCH 20.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, MARCH 11-THURSDAY, MARCH 20.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, MARCH 11

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-13/95 Suezen: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on the maintenance of workers' rights in the event of transfers of undertakings, businesses or parts of businesses. Scope of application. The cancelling of a contract with an independent builder for cleaning works and the conclusion of a contract with another independent builder. - Judgment C-264/95-P Commission v/ UIC: competition. Appeal against court judgment (third chamber enlarged), rendered June 6, 1995, in case T-14/93, UIC v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision 92/568 on a procedure under EC treaty article 85. Distribution of rail tickets by travel agencies. - Judgment C-357/95-P ENU v/ Commission: contracts. Appeal against court judgment (second chamber enlarged) rendered September 15, 1995, in cases T-458/93 and T-523/93, ENU v/ Commission. EAEC Treaty. Outflow of uranium production. - Oral procedure C-409/95 Marschall: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Obligation to give in a "predominantly masculine" category of jobs a promotion to a female candidate whose qualifications, aptitude and performance equal a competing male, unless said male candidate represents a special case.
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12

COURT OF JUSTICE, SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-104/96 Cooperatieve Rabobank "Vecht en Plassengebied": company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 68/151/EEC of March 9, 1968, co-ordinating, with a view to making equivalent, guarantees required in member states of companies within the meaning of EC treaty article 58, line 2, for the protection of company and third party interests. National regulations on company representation in cases of conflicts of interest. Statutes providing for the incompetence of a manager in engaging a company in such cases. Opposition to a third party. - Oral procedure C-5/93-P DSM v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court order (first chamber), rendered November 4, 1992, in case T-8/89 REV, DSM v/ Commission. Annulment of order rejecting the request for a revision of judgment T-8/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of decision. Polypropylene. - Oral procedure C-49/92-P Commission v/ Anic Partecipazioni: competition. Appeal against court judgment rendered December 17, 1991,in case T-6/89, Enichem Anic v/ Commission. Partial annulment of judgment T-6/89. Partial confirmation of Commission decision 86/398 of April 23, 1986. Polypropylene. - Oral procedure C-51/92-P Hercules Chemicals v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber), rendered December 17, 1991, in case T-7/89, Hercules v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-7/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of decision. Polypropylene. - Oral procedure C-199/92-P Huels v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-9/89, Huels v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-9/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment. - Oral procedure C-200/92-P ICI v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-13/89, ICI v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-13/89, partially rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment. - Oral procedure C-227/92-P Hoechst v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court order (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-10/89, Hoechst v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-10/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment. - Oral procedure C-234/92-P Shell v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court order (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-11/89, Shell v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-11/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment. - Oral procedure C-235/92-P Montecatini v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court order (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-14/89, Montecatini v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-14/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment. - Oral procedure C-245/92-P Chemie Linz v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court order (first chamber), rendered March 10, 1992, in case T-15/89, Chemie Linz v/ Commission. Annulment of judgment T-15/89, rejecting an appeal against Commission decision 86/398/EEC of April 23, 1986. Annulment of polypropylene decision by reason of court PVC judgment.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-76/94 Ladbroke Racing v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision 93/625 of September 22, 1993, concerning several aids granted by French authorities to Pari Mutuel Urbain (PMU) and horse racing companies.

FIFTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-150/95 British Iron and Steel Producers Association v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision published on December 31, 1994, declaring that aids granted by Luxembourg to the PROFILARBED company towards the construction of a new electrical fixture in Esch-Schifflange conform to article 3 of Commission decision 3855/91/ECSC of November 27, 1991, laying down EU rules on aids to the steel industry. - Oral procedure T-170/94 Shanghai Bicycle v/ Council: trade policy. Annulment of Council regulation 2474/93 of September 8, 1993, laying down a definitive anti-dumping duty on Chinese imports into the EU of bicycles and bearing on the definitive collection of the provisional anti-dumping duty. (Formerly C-47/93).
THURSDAY, MARCH 13

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-368/95 Familapress Zeitungsverlag: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 30. National legislation banning the dissemination of periodicals proposing participation in game competitions (crossword puzzles, etc.) that make it possible to win prizes of substantial value.

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-358/95 Morellato: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. National regulation banning the marketing of special frozen whole grain breads with a humidity level superior to that set nationally, and a percentage of ash under that set nationally. Legally produced product marketed in another member state.

- Opinion C-130/96 Solisnor-Estaleiros Navais: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Extent of notion of turnover tax. Stamp duties on company contracts (contract on the construction of an oil tanker). Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2)

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-109/95 Astir: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 10, paragraph 4 of Commission regulation 2730/79 of November 29, 1979, on common modes of application on export repayments on agricultural products. Exports towards a third country other than the USSR. Wheat flour. Calculation of repayment in case of loss by absolute necessity of product exported.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-103/96 Eridania Beghin-Say: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of article 9 of Council regulation 3677/86 of November 24, 1986, laying down provisions for the implementation of regulation 1999/85 on inward processing relief arrangements. Equivalent compensation mechanisms. Cane and beet root sugars. - Judgment C-131/95 Huijbrechts: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 67 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. National law by virtue of which benefits consecutive to unemployment benefits are reserved exclusively to former beneficiaries of nationally legislated unemployment benefit. - Judgment C-197/96 Commission v/ France: social policy. Non respect. Article 5, paragraph 1 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Introduction of women's night work in industry in the absence of a ban identical to that applying to men. - Opinion joined cases C-313/96, C-356/96, C-358/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have adapted laws, regulations and administrative provisions, except those applying to transportable bottled butane, propane and liquid gas, consistent with Commission directive 93/21 of April 27, 1993, applying the 18th adaptation for technical advances to Council directive 67/548/EEC, on the approximation of laws, regulations and administrative provisions on the classification, packaging and labelling of dangerous substances. - Opinion C-322/95 Iurlaro: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 15, paragraph 1(f) of Council regulation 574.72 of March 21, 1972, laying down application measures for Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU and of article 9A of Council regulation 1408/71. Reference period for the granting of invalidity pension. Worker having collected unemployment compensation in a member state where the law permits, in view of this, a prolongation of the reference period. Request for invalidity pension presented in a member state where such a prolongation is not provided for.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-131/96 Mora Romera: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6, 48 and 51 and of article 7 of Council regulation 1612/68 of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the Community. National law on social security benefit allowing a prolongation of benefit for orphans, to account for a period of interruption in training for compulsory military service. Compulsory service carried out in the forces of another member state in which the orphan has citizenship. - Oral procedure C-165/95 Lay: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council regulation 2055/93 of June 19, 1993, attributing a benchmark lot size to certain milk and milk product producers. Partial transfer of an operation. Determination of the specific benchmark lot size between the party transferor and the transferee in proportion to the grazing area. Notion of "grazing area". - Oral procedure (1045/0945 GMT) C-55/96 Job Centre: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48, 49, 55, 59, 6C, 62, 66, 86 and 90. National law excluding private companies from the exercise of worker job placement activities.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (1430/1330 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases T-195/94, T-202/94 Quiller v/ Council and Commission: agriculture. Appeal for damages. Council regulation 2187/93 of July 22, 1993, providing for the offer of damages to certain milk and milk product producers temporarily prevented from pursuing their activities.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, MARCH 18-20
TUESDAY, MARCH 18

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-282/95 P Guerin automobiles v/ Commission: competition. Judgment C-343/95 Diego Cali and Figli: competition. - Oral procedure C-20/96 Snares: free movement of persons.
THURSDAY, MARCH 20

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-24/95 Alcan Deutschland: state aid. - Opinion joined cases C-37/96, C-38/96 Sodiprem: taxation. - Opinion C-54/96 Dorsch Consult: company law. - Opinion C-158/96 Kohll: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-212/96 Chevassus-Marche: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-392/95 Parliament v/ Council: approximation of legislation.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-201/96 LTM: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-13/96 Bic Benelux: approximation of legislation. - Judgment C-96/95 Commission v/ Germany: free movement of persons. - Judgment C-294/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. - Judgment C-352/95 Phytheron International: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-45/96 Bayerische Hypothekenund Wechselbank: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-90/96 Petric: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-1/9076 Commission v/ Spain: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-223/96 Commission v/ France: environment and consumers. - Opinion joined cases C-286/94, C-340/95, C-401/95, C-47/96 Garage Molenheide: taxation. - Opinion C-389/95 Klattner: taxation. - Oral procedure C-366/95 Steff-Houlberg Export: Community resources.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-295/95 Farrell: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - Judgment C-323/95 Hayes: principles of Community law. - Opinion C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation. - Opinion C-144/96 Cirotti: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-259/95 Parliament v/ Council: environment and consumers. - Opinion C-279/94 Commission v/ Italy: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-283/95 Fischer: taxation. - Opinion C-357/96 Commission v/ Belgium: environment and consumers. - Oral procedure C-122/96 Saldanha: principles of Community law.
